A fix for past days' energy targets. Install it over 1.0.6; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.7/Spectra.apk)**

### Fixed
- **On a past day, the target and calories burned could disagree** when your target is set from your weight goal. Burned used that day's weight, but the target used today's. Both now use the day's own weight, so at Maintain, Surplus and Over target match.
- The Energy card says "the day's target" instead of "today's target" when you look at another day.
